name: Grazalema (Spain)
description: Vertically divided dark green and white, the green charged with the crowned municipal arms of Grazalema (a castle and the four bars) and the white with a green pinsapo fir.
history: Municipal flag of Grazalema; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Grazalema arms — castle and the four bars
